description:
Use this when the user asks about bulk or block trades in an Indian stock on the NSE.

Returns the bulk and block deals NSE disclosed in the stock, newest first: date, client, buy or sell, quantity and price. Each row is one client on one side; NSE does not pair a buyer with a seller. `deal_type` is "bulk" or "block" (default both); `days` is 1 to 1825 (default 90); `limit` is 1 to 500 (default 100). Deals are held from the day DalalOS began collecting them, so older ones may be absent. For trades by promoters and directors use get_insider_trades.

cursor.description: Opaque page cursor from a previous response's `next_cursor`. Echo it back to continue; page until `has_more` is false and you have the complete history.
cursor.title: Cursor

exchange.description: Exchange to read: "nse" (default), "bse" or "all". BSE rows carry BSE's own side codes (B, S, P; P is a purchase) and an exchange label.
exchange.title: Exchange

from_date.description: Optional ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) bounding the window. `from_date` replaces the `days` trailing window with an explicit floor; `to_date` sets a ceiling, which `days` alone cannot do.
from_date.title: From Date

query.description: One company: NSE symbol, ISIN or BSE code, e.g. TCS, INE467B01029 or 532540. Always send it as `query` (not `symbol`).
query.title: Query

to_date.description: Optional ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) bounding the window. `from_date` replaces the `days` trailing window with an explicit floor; `to_date` sets a ceiling, which `days` alone cannot do.
to_date.title: To Date

name: get_bulk_block_deals
title: Bulk and block deals
